perk.maniacrev.flowers_lead_the_investig: Every active survivor leaves a flower trail once every %s sec. Each flower lasts %s sec. A survivor's flower type and color stay fixed for the entire match. Only maniacs with this perk can see the trails.

guide.maniacrev.tutorial.intro.welcome: Welcome to Maniac Revolution, an asymmetric mode where survivors complete objectives while maniacs hunt them.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.intro.teams: Players are divided into survivors and maniacs. Your class, items, and available perks depend on your team.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.intro.survivor_: Survivors: hack the required computers, obtain weapons, and defeat the maniacs.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.intro.maniac_go: Maniacs: prevent the hacks and eliminate every survivor.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.intro.phases_de: The match is divided into phases. Perks may only work in the phases listed in their description.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.intro.phase_1: Phase 1 — Start: players prepare and spread across the map.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.intro.phase_2: Phase 2 — Computers: survivors hack objectives while maniacs interfere.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.intro.phase_3: Phase 3 — Reversal: survivors gain access to weapons and can fight back.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.hud.overview: The custom HUD displays the information needed for this mode without opening additional menus.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.hud.elements: Watch your health, mana, current phase, objective progress, effects, and active-perk cooldown.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.hud.mana_desc: Active perks and character abilities consume mana. The exact cost is shown in the perk or item description and updates with its gameplay value.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.before.map_desc: Vote for the map before the match. Open the Maps section to review each location.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.before.items_de: The preparation screen contains the following slots:
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.before.ready_re: Check your selections before marking yourself ready.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.before.perks_de: Build a set that matches your team and playstyle. Read the phase and activation conditions carefully.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.before.characte: Each class has its own features and starting items. Character descriptions are localized with the selected language.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.before.ready_de: When everyone is ready, the match starts on the chosen map.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.computers.start: Stand within %s blocks of a computer and interact with it to become the primary hacker.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.computers.help_: Allies within %s blocks can contribute to the same hack. Some perks modify teamwork.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.computers.qte_d: A QTE appears every %s–%s seconds. Press the displayed key while the marker is inside a scoring zone.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.computers.qte_s: Green zone: successful check and normal progress reward.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.computers.qte_c: Critical zone: a more accurate hit and a larger reward.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.computers.progr: Survivors must fully hack %s computers. The HUD shows current team progress.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.computers.glow_: Relevant computers may be highlighted briefly when the game directs players toward the next objective.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.computers.alche: The Alchemist can see brewing stands highlighted throughout the match.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.computers.end_d: After %s computers are completed, the match moves toward Reversal and survivors can obtain weapons.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.downed.overview: A survivor who takes lethal damage may enter the downed state instead of dying immediately. Allies can revive them.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.downed.normal_r: A normal survivor revives an ally in %s sec.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.downed.medic_re: The Doctor revives an ally in %s sec.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.downed.last_sur: The last active survivor cannot rely on another teammate to revive them.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.downed.timeout: If nobody helps, the downed survivor dies after %s sec.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.maps.secret_doo: Secret doors look like part of the wall but open alternate routes.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.maps.secret_hat: Hidden hatches connect floors and can change the course of a chase.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.perks.overview: Perks alter your strategy. Their descriptions use live gameplay values, so balance changes appear automatically.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.perks.active: Active — requires the perk activation key.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.perks.hybrid: Hybrid — combines passive and active behavior.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.perks.survivor: Survivor perks are available only to survivors.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.perks.maniac: Maniac perks are available only to maniacs.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.perks.common: Common perks are available to both teams.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.perks.phase_war: A perk does not work outside the phases listed on its card.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.perks.phase_any: Any phase — available throughout the match.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.perks.phase_mor: Cooldown and mana cost are shown separately and also use current gameplay values.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.end.summary: You now know the main objectives, interfaces, computer mechanics, downed state, maps, characters, and perks.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.end.community: Coordinate with your team: information and positioning are often more valuable than a risky solo play.
guide.maniacrev.tutorial.end.reopen: You can reopen this guide at any time with the configured guide key.

guide.maniacrev.character_extra.keeper_o: §5§lKeeper of Nightmares
§7The Keeper is a slow control maniac who wins through gaze pressure, survivor sanity, and nightmare trials rather than rapid attacks.
§7The Keeper cannot sprint or use a normal attack in Keeper form, so positioning and uninterrupted line of sight are crucial.
§d§lGaze and sanity
§7A sustained gaze drains a separate sanity meter shown only in matches with the Keeper.
§7Survivors should break line of sight and use cover before their sanity reaches a critical state.
§7Concentrated Nightmare removes sanity from the current gaze target and inflicts primal fear.
§c§lCocoon
§7When sanity breaks, the survivor enters a trial and a stationary cocoon appears in the normal world.
§7The cocoon has durability shown by a red bar; normal attacks are not the intended solution.
§7Breaking the cocoon in time returns the survivor from the trial.
Nightmare cocoon and durability bar
§b§lAwakening Needle
§7Awakening Needles are limited, so their carriers should avoid unnecessary risks.
§7Using a needle on a cocoon starts a tracing minigame. Accuracy below the threshold deals no damage.
§7Move carefully along the route: slipping away from the line lowers accuracy and wastes rescue time.
Awakening Needle minigame
§6§lTrials
§7At critical sanity, the survivor must complete a timed objective inside a nightmare while allies try to open the cocoon.
§7Trials split the team between rescuing the trapped player and continuing the main objectives.
Trial 1
Trial 2
Trial 3
An entity that appears on the road to death
